items.title: Run LLMs directly in browsers
items.oneliner: WebGPU-powered in-browser LLM engine with OpenAI-compatible APIs, streaming, tool calling, and private local inference.

items.title: Compare agent harnesses by cost
items.oneliner: Benchmark of nine coding harnesses shows identical models can vary 17x in cost per successful task.

items.title: Self-host Google Photos replacement
items.oneliner: Step-by-step Immich tutorial shows how to self-host photo backup and sharing with Docker on old hardware.

items.title: Benchmark a faster Wasm interpreter
items.oneliner: Wasmi 2.0 ships a portable WebAssembly interpreter with about 2.2x faster execution and reproducible benchmark tooling.

items.title: Use TinyGo with recoverable panics
items.oneliner: TinyGo 0.42 adds recoverable panics, Go 1.27 support, LLVM 22, and a minimal UEFI target.

items.title: Handle replica reads correctly
items.oneliner: Practical PostgreSQL guide explains read-your-own-writes on replicas using LSN waits and replication lag mechanics.

items.title: Speed up PostgreSQL regex queries
items.oneliner: Hands-on PostgreSQL regex benchmarks show pg_trgm cutting query time from 40 seconds to about 1.6 seconds.

items.title: Learn predicate logic for programming
items.oneliner: Programmer-friendly crash course teaches predicates, quantifiers, and logical reasoning with concrete coding examples.

items.title: Format clipboard JSON with jq
items.oneliner: Tiny jq clipboard workflow prettifies JSON on macOS or Linux and avoids wiping your clipboard on parse errors.

items.title: Explore a hobby 16-bit OS
items.oneliner: Experimental GPL hobby OS for 8086-era PCs includes source and an online emulator for immediate retro systems tinkering.
